summary.title: Port structure.runts + fix diverged is_runt metric
summary.what: Added structure.runts (Package-altitude FLATTEN_PACKAGE WARNING verdict). Rebuilt is_runt to legacy semantics in a new metrics/structural/runts.py (one non-init module + no subpackages + trivial __init__); added a tabular grammar.package_init_name fact (Grammar->None, Python->__init__.py) so non-init-convention languages are N/A. Registry 18; updated the diverged test_is_runt + added empty-package case; 5 rule tests.
summary.why: The v3 is_runt had diverged to flag empty packages, not the legacy single-module-trivial-init over-nesting signal. Restored faithfully; runts shipped standalone rather than blocked on a nonexistent general package rule.
